scope: Recoverable saved PJG research; the archive does not change the calibrated model.
notes: Paths are relative to Research; origins identify recovery locations, not build prerequisites.
Archive members preserve original bytes; gzip/tar metadata is normalized deterministically.
Readable historical reports add a status banner; original bytes are retained in source archives.
Authored archive guides and this manifest are versioned by Git, not self-hashed.
Duplicate final figures/results have origin aliases rather than duplicate payloads.
Browser state, credentials, caches, compiled executables, paper scans/OCR, redundant downloads, and full checkpoint state are excluded; saved diagnostic arrays and used inputs are retained.
Overwritten or never-saved exploratory runs cannot be recovered from these files.
AppleDouble resource-fork records from the original macOS backup are metadata, not source, and are omitted.
